name: Wide-Stance Leg Press
steps: Sit with your hips and back against the pad and set your feet wider than shoulder width with toes slightly out.
Press the sled slightly upward to disengage the safety catches while keeping your knees softly unlocked.
Bend your knees smoothly to lower the sled toward your chest while pushing your knees out in line with your angled toes.
Press evenly through both feet to extend your legs and secure the catches when finished.
tips: Stop lowering before your glutes and lower back curl upward off the backrest.
Prevent your knees from collapsing inward as you press out of the bottom.
